title: OpenSparta | Your AI Agent for Telegram
excerpt: Discover relevant conversations, manage Telegram accounts, and automate engagement with your AI-powered Telegram assistant.
content_html:
Discover relevant conversations, reach new audiences, and automate Telegram engagement with AI.

Start for Free

No credit card required.

Run Your Telegram Operations from One Workspace

Manage accounts and proxies, keep them healthy, and launch AI-powered engagement without switching between tools.

Join the Conversations That Matter

OpenSparta finds relevant Telegram conversations and writes contextual comments that help the right people discover you.

Start for Free

Questions people ask before starting

What is OpenSparta?

OpenSparta is an AI agent for Telegram. It discovers relevant conversations, automates contextual commenting, and manages your Telegram accounts and proxies from one workspace.

How much does it cost?

Paid modules and All Access are optional. See the pricing page for current prices and included AI credits.

Is it safe for my accounts?

OpenSparta uses official Telegram client protocols, per account safety limits, FloodWait quarantine and account health checks to keep your fleet stable.

Can I try it before paying?

Yes. Open any paid module in preview mode before you buy.

Ready to Automate Your Telegram Engagement?

Start free, connect your accounts, and put your AI agent to work.

Start for Free
